field_rules.aggregate_success: Exact raw outcome.success. Does not establish every selected channel succeeded.
field_rules.channel: Slots0–4 are fixed native channel names; slot5 species ID not serialized, marked unknown.
field_rules.channel_physical_records: Exact joint.channel_outcomes physical records matched to named channel. Empty list means none recorded, not failure.
field_rules.consumed_contact_observed: Exact comparison of recorded contact strings to Consumed; event flag, not persistent entity state.
field_rules.joint_channel_observations: Exact recorded executed/intensity/displacement observations, not inferred selection or primitive.
field_rules.persistent_consumed_after_tick: Always null/unknown: persistent per-tick consumed state was not logged.
field_rules.physical_success: Always null/unknown: raw has aggregate success only, not channel success.
field_rules.raw_row_index: Zero-based index in original scenario rows.
field_rules.resolved_primitive: Always null/unknown: raw did not serialize resolved Move/Interact or other motor primitive. Do not infer from kind or ID.
field_rules.selected_candidate: Null for unselected slot; otherwise exact candidate action_id/family/kind/target copied using selected candidate_index.

scope: Projection of existing disposable controlled records only. No native execution or learned checkpoint.
